title: Proxmox VE / Infrastructure
description: Node, QEMU, LXC, storage and guest I/O for prometheus-pve-exporter.

options.content: Node capacity, QEMU and LXC guests, storage, and I/O. Select one cluster scrape target; then select nodes and storage pools. **UNKNOWN / gaps mean unavailable data.**

panels.title: Collection
panels.description: Prometheus scrape success, not complete collector coverage or guest health. Missing or old samples show UNKNOWN.

targets.expr: up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness)

(pve_uptime_seconds{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Running guests
panels.description: Running QEMU and LXC guests, excluding templates. No guests yields UNKNOWN, not an invented zero.

targets.expr: (sum by(job,instance) (pve_up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"})) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_cpu_usage_limit{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Configured guest RAM
panels.description: Total configured RAM for selected non-template guests, including stopped guests.

targets.expr: (sum by(job,instance) (pve_memory_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"})) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Node sample age
panels.description: Prometheus sample age, not the age of Proxmox internal measurements.

targets.expr: (time() - timestamp(pve_node_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"})) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Already normalized by Proxmox; do not divide by CPU count again.

targets.expr: (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Proxmox-reported usage, not Linux available memory.

targets.expr: (pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"} / (pve_memory_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"} > 0)) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Storage utilization
panels.description: Capacity per storage entry. Pools can share physical disks; capacity is not backup verification.

targets.expr: (pve_disk_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"storage/.+"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(storage,node) pve_storage_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",storage=~"${storage:regex}"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"storage/.+"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(storage,node) pve_storage_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",storage=~"${storage:regex}"} > 0)) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_memory_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"node/${node:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Guest CPU utilization
panels.description: Utilization relative to configured vCPU capacity, as reported by Proxmox.

targets.expr: (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Guest memory / hypervisor view
panels.description: Not guest available memory. Stopped guests or unsupported metrics may produce gaps.

targets.expr: (pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"} / (pve_memory_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"} > 0)) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Assigned vCPUs
panels.description: Scheduling allocations, not reserved physical cores.

targets.expr: (pve_cpu_usage_limit{job="$job",instance="$instance"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_disk_size_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"storage/.+"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(storage,node) pve_storage_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",storage=~"${storage:regex}"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"storage/.+"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(storage,node) pve_storage_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",storage=~"${storage:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

(pve_disk_usage_bytes{job="$job",instance="$instance",id=~"storage/.+"} * on(job,instance,id) group_left(storage,node) pve_storage_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",storage=~"${storage:regex}"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Network receive
panels.description: Counter rate; requires at least two samples. Availability depends on guest/storage support.

targets.expr: (rate(pve_network_receive_bytes_total{job="$job",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Network transmit
panels.description: Counter rate; requires at least two samples. Availability depends on guest/storage support.

targets.expr: (rate(pve_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="$job",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Disk reads
panels.description: Counter rate; requires at least two samples. Availability depends on guest/storage support.

targets.expr: (rate(pve_disk_read_bytes_total{job="$job",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

panels.title: Disk writes
panels.description: Counter rate; requires at least two samples. Availability depends on guest/storage support.

targets.expr: (rate(pve_disk_written_bytes_total{job="$job",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job,instance,id) group_left(name,type,node) pve_guest_info{job="$job",instance="$instance",node=~"${node:regex}",template!="1"}) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="$job",instance="$instance"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) < $freshness))

options.content:
**Collection:** read-only Proxmox API → prometheus-pve-exporter → Prometheus. Scrape success is not application health. Freshness follows the selected threshold. Historical graphs describe their evaluation time, not current health.

**Storage:** pools may share disks. Free capacity is not backup freshness or restore proof. Guest memory is the hypervisor view. I/O rates use counter metrics.

Inspired by the metric model of [Proxmox via Prometheus](https://github.com/mittelab/proxmox-via-prometheus-dashboard). Native Grafana panels only; no external panel plugins.
